name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood summers spent watching rally races in the Finnish countryside. The precision and engineering captivated her, leading her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering. After graduating, she joined Racing Start Academy, drawn to their commitment to nurturing young talent. Aino believes in a meticulous approach to quality control, focusing on identifying and rectifying potential issues before they escalate into major setbacks.

Her dedication to detail and adaptability make her a valuable asset to the team. She thrives in a fast-paced environment and is always eager to learn new techniques and technologies to improve the team's performance. Aino is known for her ability to quickly identify root causes of problems and implement effective solutions, ensuring the highest standards of quality are maintained.

What sets Aino apart is her proactive approach. She's not just looking for existing problems; she's actively seeking out potential areas for improvement, contributing to a culture of continuous enhancement within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aino is of average height with a focused and alert expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work standing up, believing it improves her focus.
